figures_added.what: Exponential growth curve (bacteria count vs hours) plotting (0,1),(1,2),(2,4),(3,8),(4,16),(5,32). Theme-safe: axes and labels use currentColor, curve in soft amber #f59e0b; viewBox + role=img + aria-label. Matches the two opener boxes (16 after 4 h, 32 after 5 h) and the y=2^x reveal.
Chart.js reciprocal y=1/x, both branches in Q1 (x>0, y>0) and Q3 (x<0, y<0), for the 'which two quadrants do the branches appear in?' question. Every plotted point satisfies y=1/x (verified).
Chart.js exponential decay y=0.7^x falling from ~2.9 at x=-3 towards 0 as x increases, for the 'growth or decay?' question. Every plotted point satisfies y=0.7^x (verified).

Chart.js reciprocal y=2/x, both branches, plus dashed grey lines on the axes marking the asymptotes x=0 and y=0, for the 'what are the asymptotes?' question. Every plotted point satisfies y=2/x (verified).

coverage_note: The lesson is mostly evaluation (find y at a given x) and family-naming, for which the exam prints only the equation, so no figure is warranted. Charts were added to the three silver problems that ask the student to read a graph feature (quadrants, growth vs decay, asymptotes) off a reciprocal or exponential curve, exactly where an exam paper prints the graph. The two bronze naming MCs (which type / what shape) get no figure: showing the single answer-curve would be circular, and the exam figure for those is a set of distractor sketches this MC format cannot carry (matches the maths-aqa sibling's judgement).
notes: Figures generated programmatically from each problem's own numbers; every chart point re-verified against its equation. Validator PASS on the combined shard; live PATCH done in the single combined pass (guided + diagrams) so the row carries walks and figures together. Round-trip equality confirmed.
